repo_notes.content: The five persona paths are policy and governance, low-code builders, pro-code developers, regulators/auditors/insurers, and end users. Their human-written source of truth is docs/wiki/.
Use careful claims language: OVERT-aligned, self-assessed and demo evidence. Do not describe the project as certified, compliant, conformant or AAL-4.
docs/wiki/ is the human-written source of truth for persona guidance. Update it when user-facing behavior changes; keep relative links and match facts to repository code.
